§6Fau Armor§f

§aThe only armor that survives digamma radiation. 10 MHE per piece to keep running.§f

Fau Armor is a power armor set requiring §e10 MHE§f per piece. It provides 99.99% radiation reduction and complete digamma resistance, which no other armor offers. Set bonuses include jump boost, thermal sight, hard landing, and auditory Geiger counter.

§6Crafting§f: Each piece needs Fau armor platings (made from yharonite billets via the DFC), a demon core (closed form for the chestplate, which emits 100,000 RAD/s when closed), ancient scrap metal, and starmetal base armor.

§6Resistances§f: Fire 100%, explosion 95%, fall 100%, laser 95%, other 99%. It's the cheaper alternative to the DNT Nano Suit with nearly as much protection.

§cWARNING:§f Without power, Fau armor provides zero protection. You need a reliable charging solution. The closed demon core in the chestplate is extremely radioactive, handle with care.

§ePS:§f Essential if you plan to work with digamma fuel or spend time near DFC fields. For general endgame use, euphemium armor is more convenient.
